2608.00527.title: SSTG-Nav: Metric-Grounded Spatial-Semantic Topological Graphs for Reusable Object Navigation
2608.00527.paper_summary: Service robots operating for months in the same homes, offices, and facilities should become more reliable with experience instead of searching familiar space from scratch for every request. Yet ObjectNav is predominantly formulated as one-shot exploration, leaving a central deployment challenge unresolved: recognizing an object does not identify a reachable place to stop, and one confident map error can terminate the task. We introduce SSTG-Nav, a reusable metric-semantic memory that turns a one-time survey into actionable object goals, consolidates evidence across viewpoints, and retains spatially distinct recovery standoffs. On 1,000 HM3D-v2 episodes across 36 scenes, our goal-independent topology achieves a 99.4% geometric success ceiling. Holding semantic responses fixed, metric grounding raises SR/SPL from 0.835/0.560 to 0.920/0.603, and source-aware fusion reaches 0.926/0.586. Fusion-aware Top-3 recovery raises Success@1/2/3 to 0.928/0.965/0.975 and reaches 0.601 SPL@3. Model, field-of-view, density, and corruption controls identify where these gains originate, and a ROS2/Nav2 realization demonstrates the complete reusable query-to-execution pipeline. Together, the results establish pre-exploration as a powerful practical regime for dependable, repeated semantic navigation.
2608.00527.paper_summary_zh: 服務機器人在相同的家庭、辦公室和設施中運行數月，應該會隨著經驗變得更可靠，而不是每次請求都從頭開始搜尋熟悉的空間。 然而，ObjectNav主要被定義為一次性探索，留下了一個中心部署挑戰未解決：識別物體並不等於確定一個可達的停止位置，而一次自信的地圖錯誤可能會終止任務。 我們介紹了SSTG-Nav，一種可重用的度量語義記憶，將一次性調查轉化為可操作的物體目標，整合不同視角的證據，並保留空間上不同的恢復停頓。 在36個場景的1,000個HM3D-v2集數中，我們的目標獨立拓撲實現了99.4%的幾何成功上限。 固定語義反應的情況下，度量基準將SR/SPL從0.835/0.560提高到0.920/0.603，而源感知融合達到0.926/0.586。 融合感知的Top-3恢復將Success@1/2/3提高到0.928/0.965/0.975，並達到0.601 SPL@3。 模型、視野、密度和腐敗控制識別這些增益的來源，而ROS2/Nav2的實現展示了完整的可重用查詢到執行的管道。 總體而言，這些結果確立了預探索作為一種強大的實用模式，用於可靠的重複語義導航。
